description:
Excellent opportunity for landlords and investors to purchase this traditional style property with a tenant already in situ. Being in a highly popular location close to local supermarkets, schools and bus routes, this home is an ideal buy to let purchase. The accommodation comprises: entrance hallway, living room to the front, separate dining room to the rear and kitchen. To the first floor are two bedrooms and bathroom. Externally the property has on street parking to the front and an enclosed yard to the rear with access gate.

ENTRANCE HALLWAY Staircase to first floor.

LIVING ROOM Separate room with window to the front.

DINING ROOM Further separate room, spacious and with understairs storage cupboard and window to the rear.

KITCHEN With window and door to side and fitted with units, integrated oven/hob, tiled splashback, sink unit, extractor fan and space for appliances.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING Access to upstairs accommodation.

BEDROOM ONE Double room with window to the front.

BEDROOM TWO Single room with storage area and window to the rear.

BATHROOM Mainly tiled with window to the rear and suite comprising bath, sink, toilet and separate shower cubicle.

EXTERNALLY To the front there is ample on street parking, to the rear is an enclosed yard with access gate.

GENERAL INFORMATION Council Tax - Band A Please note all measurements including floorplans are approximate only.
